race.comment: ABENDER (3) is the one to beat with Maloney back aboard and a strong record at this track and trip. He went better than his form reads here last time after he raced wide, and his prior Eagle Farm third, beaten just under a length, showed he remains in good order. PUFF 'N' HARRY (1) was a good winner earlier in the prep and has been knocking on the door since without striking. Gets an important 3kg claim and is sure to be right there again. DIVINE SOURCE (6) wasn't as effective on the heavy track last time, so will be hoping for firmer footing third-up after scoring here fresh. Thompson's booking is a significant push. DAVIKAR (17) returns and has won first-up before. Draws well for Rodd and has trialled well. Worth keeping in mind.
